name: adpilot
description: AdPilot - multi-tenant advertising management platform (NestJS API + Vue 3 frontend)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @adpilot/api && npm run build -w @adpilot/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @adpilot/api && npm run lint -w @adpilot/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @adpilot/api && npm run test -w @adpilot/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @adpilot/api && npm run typecheck -w @adpilot/web
